required_reviewer_independence: Reviewer must not modify the runner or consume BLIND data; any defect returns the package to the author under a new version.
required_checks: reviewed git commit and all reviewed file SHA-256 values are recorded
BLIND scope and formal split hash match exactly
exclusive CONSUMED marker is created before the first BLIND read
any crash or failure after marker creation cannot be replayed
candidate-level rows paths run IDs runtime values and outcomes cannot be released
failure receipt contains no per-circuit partial values
HF/HMF action key excludes F and all outcome fields
join state rules match the preserved non-BLIND v2 semantics
receipt JSON and external SHA-256 sidecar are deterministic
real execution has not occurred during review
